events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam track, solo or with Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single released in 1975
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975, four years after its initial album release.

angles.name: Imagine release anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 51 years since John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single here in the UK. A song that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod in 2001
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the world to the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who is your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album' upon the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away at the age of 45 in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years on from his passing. His incredible voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His legacy as a musician, songwriter, and peace activist continues to resonate globally. Always in our thoughts.
